name: YONDER
source:
In the desolate sprawl of Oklahoma City, Adam undergoes a spiritual transformation after being targeted by demonic attacks.

"We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies under the sway of the wicked one."

[From [url=https://snugboat11.itch.io/yonder]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在俄克拉荷马城荒凉蔓延的城区之中，遭到恶魔袭击的亚当经历了一场灵魂的蜕变。

“我们知道，我们是属神的，全世界都卧在那恶者手下。”

[摘自[url=https://snugboat11.itch.io/yonder]itch.io[/url]]
